mission: Complete exact source-to-assertion evidence for existing unreviewed physics records
source_policy: Retained author abstracts and an ADMX full-paper page; Reuter–Saueressig and Tulin–Yu papers are explicitly author reviews used for program/model synthesis, not original empirical evidence.
notes: Revision 2 explicitly narrows flagged summaries to the stated source conditions; proposals remain proposals, exposure records denote data, and existing model/system types are revised explicitly. Complete inherited citations, tags and aliases are retained. Original r1 candidate, negative/uncertain outcomes and original baseline remain preserved. No incorrect event/quantity alias is attached to a dataset. Adds original authors Marletto/Vedral explicit 2019 BMV-proposal naming and 2017 references. Prior uncertain outcomes remain retained.
